observation.visible_scene: A plain white wall fills the frame. At the left, a hand in a black sleeve holds an upright green cup around which a sheet of water and a fan of droplets are suspended, frozen mid-spray; a soft shadow of the hand and cup falls on the wall behind it. At the right, a person in a white-and-grey striped shirt lies horizontally, head toward the right edge, body and a shoe extending toward the lower left, with a pale beige mattress edge visible along the bottom.
visible_changes: The green cup together with its frozen splash and droplet arc drifts steadily toward the lower-left corner of the frame; the cup and the spray move as one unit, keeping the same shape, indicating a slow-motion (frozen) capture rather than an evolving splash.

The lying person in the striped shirt shifts downward and rightward out of view: first the legs/shoe leave the bottom edge, then the torso, and finally only the top of the head remains at the lower-right corner before it too exits.
As the person leaves the bottom of the frame, the beige mattress edge becomes progressively more prominent along the bottom-right, occupying space previously held by the body.
The cast shadow of the hand/cup on the wall moves down and left in step with the cup, while the wall itself stays featureless.
The black-sleeved arm at the left appears to shorten / retract toward the bottom edge as the hand lowers.
Relative spacing between the cup and the striped-shirt person changes: the person descends faster than the cup, so the gap between them grows and the person ends up below the cup's vertical level.
outside_clip_unknowns: Whether the apparent downward drift is camera tilt/translation or actual motion of the cup and the lying person cannot be settled, because the wall background has no features to anchor camera movement.
The cause of the water spray and the prior state of the cup (impact, throw, etc.) are not shown; this excerpt begins with the splash already frozen in place.
What happens to the person after they exit the bottom of the frame, and whether the mattress is being landed on, is outside the visible segment.
uncertain_details: The exact dynamics of the splash are unobservable because it appears frozen across all frames; only its position relative to the frame changes.
It is unclear whether the hand is actively lowering the cup or the camera is rising relative to a static hand; the plain wall gives no parallax cue.
The identity/texture of the beige object at the bottom (mattress vs. other surface) is inferred only from its appearance at the frame edge.
